sentinel.indicators: container swelling (swollen / bulging / blown) or a sterilization / thermal-process failure, in the regulator's own Pathogen or Reason text
sentinel.note: flagged at a single record, no statistic: these hazards are below the detector's 4-record floor by nature, and one botulism case is a public-health emergency. A botulism-risk indicator is the regulator's own wording (swelling, under-sterilization), not a confirmed C. botulinum finding

novelty.why_untestable: guarded 7-week baseline is entirely zero: the sparsity ladder suppresses the stratum (mean < 1/week, no non-zero weeks) and with pi_hat = 0 the share-channel binomial is degenerate. A p-value cannot be measured against a baseline that does not exist; this is reported as a fact, not scored.
